guide: BudgetSplit(income, parts, title?, currency?) — a monthly income as a donut ring with a draggable handle on each boundary; dragging (or arrow keys) moves percent between the two neighbours, amounts recompute live in the browser. parts = [{label, percent}], 2 to 5 parts summing to 100. Use it for 'split my salary / 50-30-20 budget' questions. Sends no events; put Suggestions under it so the user's tap carries the dragged split. Example: card = BudgetSplit(80000, [{label: "Needs", percent: 50}, {label: "Wants", percent: 30}, {label: "Savings", percent: 20}])

BudgetSplit.description: An income split into parts as a donut ring with draggable boundaries.

parts.description: 2 to 5 parts whose percents sum to 100.

label.description: Name of the part, e.g. Needs.

currency.description: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.
